summary: The Scholar test suite is 59 standalone `verify-scholar-*.mjs` verifiers driven by `tests/run.mjs` (glob, alphabetical, sequential spawn, no timeout, exit-code pass/fail, `[BLOCKED]` preflight distinct from FAIL). Three verifiers directly execute the review modules (`learn-review.ts`, `review-runtime.ts`, `learn-quality.ts`) — `verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs`, `verify-scholar-review-runtime.mjs`, `verify-scholar-learn-quality.mjs` — plus `verify-scholar-reviewed-progress.mjs` (seeds/asserts receipts) and `verify-scholar-figure-coverage.mjs` (drives the role-parsed review preflight via a fixture ModelRegistry). Two verifiers actively pin v0.7.0's reviewer-free delivery path by injecting a `modelRegistry.complete` that throws if called: `verify-scholar-simple-learn.mjs` (`reviewerCalls()===0`) and `verify-scholar-obsidian-exam.mjs` (`exam_build` → `reviewerCalls===0`, `exam.review===undefined`). `verify-scholar-lesson-delivery.mjs` has no reviewer stub but pins reviewer-free readiness (`lesson.lessonReady(...)` with `reviews: []`, completion with zero receipts) and would collide if a gate returned to `lessonReady`/`recomputeProgress`. Exam is driven by ~19 verifiers (renderer/form/parse/scope/build/grading), Tutor by ~11 (grounding isolation, open-response gate, note rendering, mode-figures/input-lock). Reusable harness = `tests/sdk.mjs` (SDK discovery + jiti aliases), `tests/lesson-fixture.mjs:3 saveFixtureLesson`, `tests/note-fixture.mjs:6/18/19`, the per-file `check()` helper, and the `createScholarToolController({...}).ensureRegistered()` + fixture `ModelRegistry({complete})` port pattern.

architecture: `tests/run.mjs` is the only orchestrator. It reads its own directory, filters names by `/^verify-scholar-[a-z0-9-]+$.mjs$/`, sorts them, and spawns each as a separate Node process (sequential `for`, `stdio: inherit`, exit code 0 = pass) with a temp cwd and a scrubbed env (PI_SCHOLAR_EXTENSION/PI_SCHOLAR_PI_PACKAGE/PI_SCHOLAR_STATE_ROOT set; PI_SCHOLAR_LIBRARY_ROOT, PI_SCHOLAR_OBSIDIAN_ROOT, SCHOLAR_DESIGN_PREVIEW deleted). A preflight `try` loads `tests/sdk.mjs`, `checkSdkFiles()`, the Pi loader and jiti, and rejects an empty file list; failure prints `[BLOCKED] Test environment: <msg>` and exits 1 *before* any verifier runs — that is semantically distinct from a verifier FAIL (per-file `[FAIL] <file>` plus the final `Scholar: N verifier(s) passed, M failed.`). No per-verifier timeout or parallelism exists. Each verifier is self-contained: a local `check(name, …)` accumulator, jiti (via sdk.mjs aliases) to import `.ts` modules directly, and for tool-level flows a `createScholarToolController({pi:{registerTool}, session, getConfig, loadBook, mutateBook, isActiveAuthority, isSetupActive})` port wired to a fixture book; model behaviour comes from a fixture `ModelRegistry` (or an ad-hoc `{complete}` object) built from `piPackageRoot/dist/core/model-registry.js`. Review code is never reachable from the runtime at HEAD (no production file imports learn-review/review-layer/review-runtime except learn-review.ts→review-layer.ts, and `runtime-coordinator.ts` imports only the `ReviewerProgress` *type*), so review verifiers import the review modules directly by path.
report:
## 1. `tests/run.mjs` — discovery, execution, pass/fail, blocked

**Discovery / order / parallelism / timeout**
- `run.mjs:9` — `const files = (await readdir(directory)).filter((name) => /^verify-scholar-[a-z0-9-]+\.mjs$/.test(name)).sort();` — glob is a filename regex on the tests dir, alphabetically sorted. `run.mjs`, `sdk.mjs`, `lesson-fixture.mjs`, `note-fixture.mjs` do **not** match, so helpers are never executed as verifiers.
- `run.mjs:43` — `for (const file of files) {` … `run.mjs:51` `spawn(process.execPath, [join(directory, file)], { cwd: temporary, env, stdio: "inherit", windowsHide: true })`. **Fully sequential; no `timeout` option; no `Promise.all`.** A hung verifier hangs the suite.
- `run.mjs:45-49` — per-child env: sets `PI_SCHOLAR_EXTENSION`, `PI_SCHOLAR_PI_PACKAGE`, `PI_SCHOLAR_STATE_ROOT: join(temporary,"bootstrap")`; `delete` of `PI_SCHOLAR_LIBRARY_ROOT`, `PI_SCHOLAR_OBSIDIAN_ROOT`, `SCHOLAR_DESIGN_PREVIEW`.

**Pass/fail signal**
- `run.mjs:52` — `child.once("exit", (code) => done(code === 0));` — a verifier passes iff its process exits 0. Each verifier ends with `console.log(...summary...)` + `process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0` (e.g. `verify-scholar-lesson-delivery.mjs` last lines; `verify-scholar-appearance.mjs:377-378`; `verify-scholar-learn-review.mjs:439`).
- `run.mjs:58` — per-file `[${passed ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}] ${file}`.

**Summary line**
- `run.mjs:61` — `console.log(`\nScholar: ${files.length - failures} verifier(s) passed, ${failures} failed.`);` `run.mjs:62` sets `process.exitCode`.

**Preflight / `BLOCKED` vs `FAIL` / count**
- `run.mjs:20-31` — `try { sdk = await import("./sdk.mjs"); sdk.checkSdkFiles(); await import(loaderPath); await import(jitiPath); if (files.length === 0) throw new Error("No packaged verifiers were found."); } catch { console.error(`[BLOCKED] Test environment: ${error.message}`); … process.exit(1); }` — `BLOCKED` means *no verifier ran* (missing SDK/jiti/marked dependency or zero verifiers), as opposed to `FAIL` (a verifier ran and exited non-zero).
- `run.mjs:35-38` — `--preflight` prints `[PASS] SDK and test dependencies load.` and exits 0.
- **Verifier count:** printed only by `--list` (`run.mjs:12` `` `${files.length} packaged verifiers` ``). **No verifier asserts the count**; the only count-adjacent assertion is `run.mjs:26` (non-empty). `verify-scholar-package.mjs:11` asserts `manifest.pi.extensions` deep-equals `["./index.ts"]`, a different invariant.

## 3. Verifiers pinning v0.7.0's reviewer-free delivery path

**`verify-scholar-simple-learn.mjs` (hard pin)** — `:69-70` injects a registry that throws if any reviewer runs:
```js
const context = { hasUI: false, model: { id: "simple-learn", provider: "fixture", api: "fixture", … },
  modelRegistry: { complete: async () => { reviewerCalls++; throw new Error("no reviewer may run"); } } };
```
Assertions that collide with a review gate:
- `:85-91` `await check("lessonComplete commits with zero reviewer model requests", …)`: `assert.notEqual(result.details.tone, "retry")`, `assert.notEqual(result.details.tone, "error")`, `assert.equal(h.reviewerCalls(), 0, "no reviewer model may be called")`, `assert.match(result.content[0].text, /Full lesson saved/)`. A reintroduced review in `action:"notes" lessonComplete` calls the stub → throws → tone becomes error/retry → all four fail.
- `:93-95` `domain.recomputeProgress(...)` then `assert.notEqual(h.section.status, "complete")` + `assert.deepEqual(domain.quickQuestionBlockers(h.section), ["3 more short questions"])` — no review step is expected between commit and completion.
- `:103-112` three resolved questions (one `review`-outcome, one `cancelled`) → `assert.equal(section.status, "complete")` with no receipts anywhere.

**`verify-scholar-obsidian-exam.mjs` (hard pin)** — `:578-591`:
```js
await check("exam_build freezes the form without calling a reviewer model", async () => {
  const h = await harness("no-review", { status: "draft" });
  h.context.modelRegistry = { complete: async () => { reviewerCalls++; throw new Error("reviewer must not run"); } };
  const buildRes = await h.execute({ action: "exam_build", questions: draftQuestions });
  assert.equal(reviewerCalls, 0, "exam_build must not call a reviewer model");
  assert.ok(!["review", "error", "retry"].includes(buildRes.details.tone), buildRes.content[0]?.text);
  assert.equal(activeExam.status, "active");
  assert.equal(activeExam.review, undefined);
});
```
`assert.equal(activeExam.review, undefined)` (`:591`) additionally fails if a review receipt is persisted onto the exam record.

**`verify-scholar-lesson-delivery.mjs` (soft pin — no reviewer stub, but readiness/completion assertions collide)** — the fixture (`:14-18`) has no `learnQuality.reviews`, yet:
- `assert(lesson.lessonReady(section, book.source.fingerprint.sha256));` (after `save({lessonComplete:true})`) and `assert(lesson.lessonReady(section));` (after the note round-trip) — if `lessonReady` regains the receipt gate that `verify-scholar-reviewed-progress.mjs:129` presupposes, both fail with empty `reviews`.
- `domain.recomputeProgress(book,section); assert.equal(section.status,"complete")` after pushing three `pass` attempts — collides if `recomputeProgress` requires `earnedDelivery`/receipts.

**`verify-scholar-ui-contract.mjs` (review-*tolerant*, not a pin)** — `:161-170` the stub comments “Exercise the production review preflight without a network/model account” and returns either `{status:"pass",findings:[]}` or a `read_source`/`view_source` toolCall depending on the prompt. Reintroducing review would **not** fail this file; its `tone === "review"` assertions (`:240`, `:286`) belong to *outline validation*, not the delivery review layer.
